name: Agent Control
description: For the Agent Control desk display of Claude Code sessions: brings a session's terminal window to the front when its row is tapped, and marks it in the display's colour for the session's state (two rings pulse out, then an outline and a tab with the session's title stay until the focus moves on). Under Wayland only code running inside gnome-shell can raise a window, so the agent-control-window helper asks this extension over D-Bus.
